rules: Labels/Overlines must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Do not exceed text-6xl for hero/headings.
H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight font-black.
H2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold

colors.strategy: Functional Color. UI is mostly monochrome. Color exists to guide action.
rules: Never use pure black or pure gray. Always tint neutrally (e.g. Slate/Zinc).
Explicitly set hover states: hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white.
Focus states must have higher contrast.
Text on surfaces must maintain 4.5:1 ratio.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
spacing_and_layout.bento_rules: Summary widgets: col-span-1. Primary Data: col-span-2 row-span-2. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing internally: p-6, p-8 for containers. Add padding if container has a border to prevent text collision.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content and forms. Do not center-align app container.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.headers: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark). 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/20).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.grid_borders: For data-heavy areas, use visible grid skeletons (border-collapse, border-r, border-b).

components_and_interactions.navigation: Collapsible left-sidebar (280px) for modules + Topbar for Global Search (Command Palette style) and Notification bell.
components_and_interactions.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn components only. Do not use native HTML inputs. Left-aligned labels.
components_and_interactions.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Strong hover/active animations (scale down).
components_and_interactions.tables: High density, screen-reader friendly. Subtle borders for rows, no excessive padding.
components_and_interactions.charts: Shadcn chart components / Recharts. Accessible color palettes.

rules: Hover states for all interactive elements.
Entrance animations: staggered for lists and dashboard widgets.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative elements.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Examine them before creating new ones.
Import Manrope and IBM Plex Sans from Google Fonts.

specific_instructions_for_infissi_expres.i18n: Predispose i18n system. Default language: Italian (it). Only Italian visible initially.
specific_instructions_for_infissi_expres.auth: Custom email/password (no social login). Include Password Reset and First-time password change.
specific_instructions_for_infissi_expres.dashboard: Widgets: counters, last activities, recent audits, notifications. Include North Star metric on top-left.
specific_instructions_for_infissi_expres.sidebar: Modular navigation (Lead, Cliente, Preventivo, Contratto, ecc.).
specific_instructions_for_infissi_expres.topbar: Global search (multi-collection), notification bell, user menu.
specific_instructions_for_infissi_expres.data_density: High density data tables for manufacturing, precision layout, sharp UI edges.
specific_instructions_for_infissi_expres.settings: Company settings (data, logo, progressive numeration, locale).
